;; Fixture for the navigation features: outline kinds, definition jumps and
;; occurrence highlighting all read this one file.
;;
;; It must analyze cleanly. A single rejected form empties documentSymbol and
;; nulls every definition and hover reply for the whole file (navigation plan
;; §4.2.1), which would make these tests fail for a reason unrelated to what
;; they check.
(def nav-total 10)
(defn nav-double [n : int] : int (* n 2))
(defstruct NavPoint :copy [x : int y : int])
(defmacro nav-twice [x] x)

;; nav-total appears in this comment, and below inside a string literal.
;; Neither is a use, and neither may be highlighted as one.
(def nav-note "nav-total in a string")

(defn nav-use [] : int (nav-double nav-total))
(defn nav-use-again [] : int (+ nav-total 1))

;; `list-head` is defined in the bundled stdlib, so a definition jump from here
;; has to open a tab outside the workspace — the read-only case.
(defn nav-stdlib [] : int (list-head (tcons 1 (tnil))))
